name: Agence de Régulation du Secteur de l'Eau potable et de l'Energie électrique (ARSEE) — Gabon
notes: Search (French) identifies arseegabon.com as the official ARSEE site; DNS resolution fails (ENOTFOUND) for both arseegabon.com and www.arseegabon.com. RegulaE.Fr members page lists ARSEE with no URL. Domain appears lapsed.

name: Autorité de Régulation du Secteur de l'Energie électrique (ARSE) — Tchad
notes: WARNING: arse.td (cited in search results as the regulator's official site) now serves Turkish online-gambling spam ('Grandpashasbet') — the domain appears hijacked or lapsed and resold. Do NOT crawl. ARSE itself exists (created 2019, member of RegulaE.Fr, no URL listed there).

name: Ministerio de Industria y Energía — Guinea Ecuatorial
notes: No independent electricity regulator found for Equatorial Guinea (sector overseen by ministry + SEGESA utility). Both ministry domains found in Spanish search — minindustria.gob.gq and mmie.gob.gq — returned HTTP 503 on every attempt.

name: Autoridade Geral de Regulação (AGER) — São Tomé e Príncipe
notes: Multisector regulator (telecoms, post, water, electricity), created by Decreto-Lei 14/2005. Electricity section at /index.php/pt/electricidade is informational (EMAE as operator); legislation and market-observatory pages exist but no consolidated licensee register found. Server-rendered HTML (Joomla), Portuguese with English version.

name: Autorité de Régulation de l'Electricité (ARELEC, ex-ORE) — Madagascar
notes: ORE became ARELEC (Décret 2025-852, Aug 2025, per press). Legacy site www.ore.mg returned HTTP 503; ministry page meh.mg/arelec/ (and meh.mg root) returned HTTP 403 (WAF). No working ARELEC site opened in this task — route to a human.

name: Agence de Développement de l'Electrification Rurale (ADER) — Madagascar
notes: register: https://www.ader.mg/operateurs-et-autres-infos-utiles/ — Official rural electrification agency (WordPress, French). Homepage opened fine and links appel-a-projet/, appel-doffres/, operateurs-et-autres-infos-utiles/; however the operators subpage served an anti-bot 'please wait / verification' interstitial to the fetcher, so deep crawling will need JS/WAF handling.

name: Utility Regulatory Authority (URA) — Mauritius
notes: Official regulator for electricity, water, wastewater. Static HTML with PDF legislation, tariff determinations (latest 2026 temporary charges notice), press releases and Gazette notices. No public consolidated licensee register visible; licensing runs through a separate JS/login portal at online.uramauritius.mu. Note: ura.mu does not resolve — uramauritius.mu is the working domain.

name: Seychelles Energy Commission (SEC)
notes: Confirmed as official domain via search (statutory body under Energy Act 2012, issues electricity licences), but www.sec.sc returned HTTP 503 on repeated attempts; search results note the site is 'under construction'.

name: Société Nationale d'Electricité des Comores (SONELEC)
notes: Comoros has no energy regulator yet (a Conseil National de Régulation de l'Énergie is only planned, per COMESA search result). The national utility SONELEC's site soneleccomores.com timed out on DNS (ETIMEOUT, with and without www).

name: Agência Reguladora Multissectorial da Economia (ARME) — Cabo Verde
notes: register: https://www.arme.cv/index.php?option=com_content&view=category&id=93&Itemid=774 — Multisector regulator (energy, water, comms, transport), Joomla site in Portuguese. Electricity category confirmed: regulations, tariff decisions, statistics, public consultations, plus 'Operadores/Empresas Reguladas' section; documents served via jdownloads PDF categories. Fresh documents dated Aug 2026 (weekly fuel reports).

name: ECOWAS Regional Electricity Regulatory Authority (ERERA)
notes: Known official domain erera.arrec.org returned HTTP 403 on both https and http attempts — WAF/anti-bot block, not a dead domain. Route to a human or browser-based crawler.

name: Energy Regulators Association of East Africa (EREA)
notes: register: https://energyregulators.org/publications/ — Confirmed EREA (est. 2008, Arusha). WordPress site in English publishing member-regulator info, secretariat reports (/secretariat-reports/), regulatory research, EAC Petroleum Regulatory Index, electricity/petroleum statistics and an EAC Energy Dashboard/Data Hub (dashboard likely JS).

name: Regional Energy Regulators Association of Southern Africa (RERA)
notes: Confirmed RERA (SADC). Homepage opened at rerasadc.com but internal links resolve to rera.omalaetiit.com (members directory of 11 regulators at /members, resource library of technical reports and annual statistics at /resources) — a hosting mirror worth noting for crawler canonicalisation. PHP site with JS carousels; English.

name: African Forum for Utility Regulators (AFUR)
notes: Pan-African utility regulators forum (secretariat Pretoria; membership continent-wide, ISO list here shows seat only). Bilingual EN/FR HTML site; homepage is conference-focused (23rd Annual Conference, Monrovia 2027); member lists/publications not surfaced on homepage — deeper crawl needed.

name: World Bank Projects & Operations
notes: register: https://search.worldbank.org/api/v3/projects?format=json — The HTML page is an empty JS application shell (only 'Projects' heading renders), but the underlying JSON API at https://search.worldbank.org/api/v3/projects?format=json&countrycode_exact=NG was opened and confirmed: full project records with country, sector codes, amounts, board approval dates, pagination. Crawl the API, not the page.

name: IFC Disclosure Portal
notes: register: https://disclosures.ifc.org/ — Central disclosure hub for IFC investment and advisory projects with country and industry dropdown filters plus advanced search. Hybrid static HTML + JS: navigation is static but the recent-disclosures listing populates dynamically, so the project search itself is JS-driven.

name: Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency (MIGA)
notes: HTTP 403 Forbidden on the projects register URL — WAF blocks non-browser fetchers. A human with a browser should confirm the guarantee-projects register, which historically lists projects by country/sector.

name: African Development Bank (AfDB) projects portal / MapAfrica
notes: projectsportal.afdb.org is DNS-dead (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND). mapafrica.afdb.org and www.afdb.org both return HTTP 403 from a WAF. The whole AfDB estate blocks non-browser crawlers; a human/browser-based crawler is needed. High-value target since it is the largest Africa-only project database.

name: Sustainable Energy Fund for Africa (SEFA)
notes: HTTP 403 Forbidden — same AfDB WAF as the main projects portal. SEFA project approvals therefore unverifiable by automated fetch; route a human here.

name: British International Investment (BII)
notes: HTTP 403 Forbidden on both the site root and the portfolio search page (/en/our-impact/search-results/) — WAF blocks automated fetchers entirely. BII's investment database is known to be filterable by country/sector; needs a browser-based crawler or manual capture.

name: Proparco (Groupe AFD)
notes: register: https://www.proparco.fr/en/projects/list — Searchable project database, 20 project cards per page across 39 pages, filterable by year of signature, sector, location, financing type, client type; shows amounts in EUR. Traditional HTML with pagination, plus a link to the full dataset on Opendata (French open data portal). French-first site with English mirror.

name: FMO (Dutch Entrepreneurial Development Bank) World Map
notes: register: https://www.fmo.nl/worldmap — 1,316 investments listed with organisation name, amount, date, country, sector. Filterable by country, publication year (2017-2026), status (proposed/contracting/approved/completed), sector (incl. Energy) and funding source (incl. Access to Energy Fund, Building Prospects). Server-rendered with classic pagination across 66+ pages — ideal crawl target. No bulk download.

name: DEG (Deutsche Investitions- und Entwicklungsgesellschaft) investment disclosure database
notes: register: https://deginvest-investments.de/ — Dedicated disclosure database of DEG commitments since 2015, filterable by region, country, sector, year, customer. Listing renders via JS (page shows '0 Results' without JS) BUT a 'Download CSV' export is offered, which is the crawl path. Site states ~90-93% of recent commitments are published.

name: Norfund investment overview
notes: register: https://www.norfund.no/investment-overview/ — Interactive drill-through investment directory (PowerBI-style JS embed) covering all direct and fund investees, plus a bulk Excel download of the full investment database, last updated April 2026. Crawl the Excel, not the embed. Renewable energy is one of Norfund's four core areas.

name: Private Infrastructure Development Group (PIDG) — portfolio incl. EAIF and InfraCo Africa
notes: register: https://pidg.org/portfolio/ — Filterable portfolio (sector incl. Power/Energy, location, solution incl. Guarantee/Debt/Project Development) with 11 pages of project cards; JS-powered filtering. IMPORTANT: infracoafrica.com and eaif.com project pages have been shut down and 301 into pidg.org — this is now the single register for EAIF, InfraCo Africa and GuarantCo. Project-level impact data is separately downloadable as an annua

name: Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (GEAPP)
notes: register: https://energyalliance.org/projects/ — Lists 17 projects (DRE, BESS, Just Energy Transition, Pilot Programmes) with country filter; WordPress site, hybrid HTML with JS client-side filtering — project cards are in the HTML. Partner organisations are not named on cards; individual project pages and the 'Our partners' page carry the organisation names. Note /investments/ and /our-work/ return 404 — /projects/ is the current path.

name: Climate Investment Funds (CIF)
notes: register: https://www.cif.org/projects — Project database filterable by program (CTF, SREP, FIP, PPCR, ACT, ARISE), topic, country, implementing MDB, status, sector and SDG. AJAX-loaded card/list views with pagination; project cards link to detail pages. No visible bulk download — crawler must drive the AJAX endpoints or paginate.

name: Green Climate Fund (GCF) project portfolio and Open Data Library
notes: register: https://data.greenclimate.fund/ — Portfolio hub (359 projects, $20.4B) linking to all-projects browsing by region/country/sector. The dedicated Open Data Library at https://data.greenclimate.fund/ (opened, confirmed) is a Next.js app exposing Funded Activities, Countries, Entities and Readiness databases with funding/disbursement/impact figures — the structured-data crawl path.

name: REPP (Renewable Energy Performance Platform, managed by Camco)
notes: register: https://repp.energy/projects/ — Projects page lists ~43 portfolio companies/projects as HTML cards with name, country and technology (e.g. ARC Power Rwanda mini-grids, Mwenga Tanzania wind, Nuru DRC solar-hybrid grids, Bboxx SHS), each linking to a detail page; separate map view. WordPress, plain HTML, English/French/Portuguese versions. Note: /portfolio/ is 404 — current path is /projects/. REPP 2 (GCF-backed successor) is docu

name: EDFI Management Company — ElectriFI / AgriFI investment database
notes: register: https://edfimc.eu/our-projects/ — 137 investments listed with name, year, countries, sector (Solar PV, Clean cooking, etc.), facility (ElectriFI/AgriFI), business model and stage (Contracted/Disbursed/Exited). Filterable by 43 countries, sector, year, facility; map and list views. JS-driven filtering but project entries were present in fetched HTML. Note: electrifi.eu now 301-redirects to edfimc.eu — this is the canonical ElectriF

name: CEI Africa (Clean Energy and Energy Inclusion for Africa Foundation)
notes: WordPress site describing two funding windows (results-based financing and crowdlending) for off-grid and mini-grid companies in Sub-Saharan Africa. No portfolio/investee register page exists (/portfolio/ is 404); investees are only disclosed via news posts (e.g. EUR 2m into Spark). Crawl target would be the news feed.

name: Acumen portfolio companies directory
notes: register: https://acumen.org/companies/ — Page self-describes as 'an A to Z directory of all the companies we've invested in since 2001', but the company list, country and sector filters load via JavaScript — fetched HTML contains no company entries. Needs a headless-browser crawler or discovery of the underlying JSON endpoint.

name: responsAbility Investments (Climate Finance / Access to Clean Power)
notes: Informational theme page only — describes renewable energy, energy access and green lending focus areas and links to fund product pages. No public investee database exists on the site; individual deals surface only through press releases. /en/investments returns 404.

name: Mirova (absorbed SunFunder; Gigaton Fund)
notes: sunfunder.com now 301-redirects to mirova.com (confirmed by fetch). Mirova's site has strategy pages (Energy Transition Infrastructure) but no portfolio/holdings listing and no Gigaton Fund investee register; Gigaton deals (e.g. SunCulture, Solar Panda) appear only in news releases. Crawl target would be the news section.

name: Oikocredit partner directory
notes: oikocredit.coop 301-redirects to oikocredit.org, which returns HTTP 403 to automated fetchers (WAF). The partner directory (historically filterable by country and sector incl. renewable energy) needs browser-based capture.

name: U.S. Trade and Development Agency (USTDA)
notes: WordPress site with Energy industry and Africa/MENA region sections, but no unified searchable activities/transactions database was found — /activities/ is 404 and navigation only offers project-opportunity pages (/work/...) and a dated news feed. Grant-level data would have to come from the news feed or USAspending.gov.

name: Power Africa (USAID)
notes: HTTP 404 — Power Africa's site is gone following the 2025 dismantling of USAID; press reporting confirms the programme was terminated and its Tracking Tool (PATT) is offline. Historical transaction data survives only on archived USAID snapshots (2017-2020.usaid.gov) and the Wayback Machine.

name: LinkedIn (manual research source)
notes: Manual research only. The User Agreement prohibits automated scraping, so the crawler never fetches it; profile URLs may be stored as reference links and consulted by a human. Tier 7 under docs/04.

name: Africa Solar Industry Association (AFSIA) — membership directory
notes: register: https://afsiasolar.com/members/membership-directory/ — Opened and confirmed public: plain-HTML directory of 100+ members with headquarters, activity categories and website URLs, filterable by country and activity (e.g. AG Energies, Tanzania — Developer, EPC, Equipment Distributor). The member-zone Projects DB and Companies DB (/member-zone/) are login-walled: do not crawl those.

name: AFSIA Solar Awards — winners by year
notes: Opened and confirmed public: winners 2020-2025 by category, naming BOTH companies and their projects (e.g. CrossBoundary Energy for Jabi Lake Mall, Lagos; Sterling & Wilson for 322 MW at Benban). Company-to-project pairs make this a project-party lead source, not just a directory.

name: Climate Fund Managers (Climate Investor One / Two)
notes: register: https://climatefundmanagers.com/investments/ — Opened and confirmed: plain-HTML portfolio of 20+ projects across CI1/CI2 with names, countries and technologies (Twiga wind TZ; AHH hydro UG; Red Sea Power wind DJ; Konexa NG).

name: Facility for Energy Inclusion (FEI) — AfDB-conceived, Cygnum-managed
notes: register: https://feiafrica.com/portfolio — Opened and confirmed: ~13-14 borrowers with operating countries across Telecom ESCO, C&I, IPP and mini-grid sectors (Camusat/AktivCo across 7 countries; Cicada Solar ZW; CrossBoundary Energy across 10; NuRAN Wireless CM/CD). Webflow HTML with JS filters.

name: Cygnum Capital (ex Lion's Head) — asset management
notes: register: https://www.cygnumcapital.com/asset-management — Opened and confirmed: manager of seven funds, each with its own portfolio site named on the page: ALCBF (alcbfund.com), OGEF (ogefafrica.com), FEI (feiafrica.com — verified separately), AfricaGoGreen (agg-fund.com), E3 (e3-cap.com), AATIF (aatif.lu), UGEAP. Those sister-fund portfolio pages are leads to verify individually; OGEF is the most atlas-relevant.

name: Shell Foundation — portfolio
notes: register: https://shellfoundation.org/our-portfolio/ — Opened and confirmed: 50-80+ partner companies with region, country, technology and customer-group filters (Ampersand e-transport East Africa; SunCulture solar pumps; KOFA; Jaza Energy). JS-driven filtering — crawler needs the underlying endpoint or headless rendering.

name: All On (Shell-seeded, Nigeria off-grid impact investor)
notes: Site is live but fully JS-rendered — the homepage serves only a shell and no portfolio path could be located server-side (/investments/ 404s). Press coverage credits 36+ Nigerian investee companies since 2018, so the portfolio page is worth locating in a browser by hand. Do not crawl until a server-rendered or API path is found.

name: Inspired Evolution (Evolution I-III funds)
notes: Site is live but renders only a 'Loading…' JS shell server-side; the portfolio is not reachable without a browser. Known Evolution III investees from press: Red Rocket Group, CrossBoundary Energy (USD 40m, 2024-25). Locate the portfolio path by hand before any crawl.
